title: Setup: build Spring Boot #52593 (S41) at both pins and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-boot-merged-pr-links-s01-s50-brief.md, case S41 (spring-projects/spring-boot#52593: The inspected byte count matches a writer’s slice). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/S41-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-boot-pr-links-s01-s50), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of buildpack:spring-boot-buildpack-platform with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names on JDK 25, runs the landed test classes (InspectedContentTests (test) ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of buildpack:spring-boot-buildpack-platform in $P/artifacts/S41-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned S41

resources.notes: rerun after the second (project-closure) resolution pass; first run failed in about 5 min on offline misses or the generated-jar check

steps.name: S41 fix: build and landed tests
S41 parent: build and the parent's tests
S41 transplant: the fix's tests on the parent
